title: Assessing Recent Knife Attacks and Additional Safeguards to Provide Safety Assurance
what_it_is: Assessing Recent Knife Attacks and Additional Safeguards to Provide Safety Assurance

sections.label: Knife crime cases in 2024
sections.summary: In 2024 there were 129 knife-related cases, comparable to the average of 133 a year from 2021 to 2023, with one attack at St Joseph's Church.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As of November 2024, there were 129 cases of murder, attempted murder, robbery, rioting and serious hurt involving knives in 2024.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This is comparable to the number of cases in the preceding three years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Between 2021 and 2023, there was an average of 133 cases a year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: None of these crimes occurred at a place of worship, with the sole exception of the knife attack at St Joseph's Church in November 2024.

sections.label: Regulation of daggers and swords
sections.summary: MHA regulates the sale of six daggers, swords, spears, spearheads, bayonets and dangerous bows and arrows, expanding to flick knives and knuckle dusters in 2025.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Through the Arms and Explosives Act, MHA currently regulates the sale of six of these daggers, swords, spears, spearheads, bayonets and dangerous bows and arrows.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This will be expanded to include flick knives and knuckle dusters when the Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control Act is operationalised in the first half of 2025.

sections.label: Congregation subdues church attacker
sections.summary: Two men subdued the attacker and other congregation members gave the priest first aid, preventing further casualties and minimising his injury before authorities arrived.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Two men helped subdue the attacker, while other members of the congregation provided first aid to the priest.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Their actions prevented further casualties and minimised the injury to the priest before the authorities arrived on the scene.
